title: fix: resolve source_name to dict key in find_by_path to fix credential application for operationPath steps

raw.title: fix: resolve source_name to dict key in find_by_path to fix credential application for operationPath steps
raw.body:
### Summary

When `operationPath` uses a `$sourceDescriptions` expression (e.g. `{$sourceDescriptions.discord.url}#/paths/~1channels/post`), `find_by_path` receives the evaluated URL as `source_url`. The `_find_source_description` fallback correctly locates the matching spec, but `find_by_path` was setting `source_name = source_url` (the raw URL) instead of the actual `source_descriptions` dictionary key.

This caused `extract_security_requirements` to fail its `source_name in self.source_descriptions` lookups (lines 700 & 711), silently skipping path-level and global security requirements. The result: **requests were sent without credentials** whenever a step used an `operationPath` reference.

### Changes

- **`operation_finder.py`** -- `_find_source_description` now returns `tuple[str, dict]` (canonical key + spec) instead of just the spec dict. `find_by_path` unpacks both values so `source_name` is always the dictionary key, not the URL.
- **`test_operation_finder.py`** -- Added `TestFindByPathSourceNameForSecurityResolution` regression test class (4 tests) covering URL-based and Arazzo-expression-based lookups, asserting that `source` is the dict key and that `extract_security_requirements` returns the expected schemes.
- **`pyproject.toml`** -- Version bump `0.9.3` -> `0.9.4`.

### Test plan

- [x] All 267 tests pass (0 failures, 8 skipped)
- [x] New regression tests verify `source` field is the dict key after URL lookup
- [x] New regression tests verify `source` field is the dict key after expression lookup
- [x] New regression tests verify `extract_security_requirements` returns correct schemes end-to-end
- [x] Existing `TestFindByPathJsonPointerDecoding` tests still pass (no regression on `~1` decode fix)
- [x] Existing `TestOperationFinderWithTwoSources` multi-source routing tests still pass
- [x] Workflow integration tests (`test_workflow_with_multiple_api_sources`) pass
- [x] Fixture discovery tests (xkcd, newyork_times, discord, etc.) pass
